---
title: "Pipes"
---

Banking systems run on pipes.

Data moves across domains (Risk, Finance, Treasury, Markets) through ingestion, transformation, aggregation, reconciliation, and control layers.

This section focuses on the **structures that keep pipelines reliable under supervisory scrutiny**:

- Data lineage and traceability patterns  
- Governance operating models (ownership, approvals, change boundaries)  
- Data contracts and validation controls  
- Minimal reference architectures for regulated environments  
- AI readiness foundations (what must be true before AI can scale)
